scope: angular sensitivity, not equivalence in human-perceived quality
source: all saved real_controls native TEST cohorts, no subset chosen by scores
amplitude: fixed local SO(3) angle at all21nonroot joints; global consequences accumulate along kinematic chains
coherence: FK with per-clip initial bone lengths; recomputed RIC positions, local velocities and foot contacts; root trajectory fixed
crop: last4frames removed to derive velocities from available next-frame positions; common crop for all controls
FID_reference: paired zero-angle coherent embedding cohort; also report original-to-zero reconstruction FID separately
